## What We Do

The Man Wanders Globe is a premium travel agency that designs bespoke domestic and international travel experiences. We handle every aspect of a trip — flights, hotels, transfers, activities, dining recommendations and local experiences — so our clients can focus entirely on enjoying their journey.

## Key Services

- **Domestic travel packages:** Rajasthan, Kerala, Goa, Himachal Pradesh, Ladakh, Kashmir, Andaman Islands, and more
- **International travel packages:** Maldives, Bali, Dubai, Paris, Santorini, Singapore, Thailand, Sri Lanka, Switzerland, Egypt, South Africa, South Korea, Japan, China, Bhutan, Nepal
- **Honeymoon packages:** Romantic curated escapes, overwater villas, private dinners
- **Family holidays:** Kid-friendly itineraries, safe and comfortable travel
- **Luxury travel:** Heritage hotels, private experiences, premium airlines
- **Adventure travel:** Trekking, scuba diving, camping, high-altitude expeditions
- **Corporate/MICE travel:** Team retreats, incentive trips, conference travel
- **Solo travel:** Guided and independent travel for solo adventurers

## What Makes Us Different

- Every itinerary is designed by a human specialist, not an algorithm
- We have personally visited every destination we recommend
- 24/7 support during travel via WhatsApp
- End-to-end handling: flights, hotels, transfers, activities, all in one place
- Transparent pricing with itemised quotes
- 4.9★ Google rating across 5,000+ travellers served
